newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up on institutional support.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended up on Tuesday with institutional buying supporting shares with heavy index weighting, including Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co Ltd and Pudong real estate shares, brokers said.
The B index edged up 0.468 points or 0.52 percent to 90.513 points on volume of 21.012 million shares worth $17.181 million.
Brokers said institutional support from big firms stabilized the B share market even though losers outnumbered gainers.

"Domestic institutions were seen supporting big companies, but most investor funds, especially overseas capital, remained sidelined due to uncertainty about the government's measures to cool the overheating market," said one broker.
"The technical charts indicated that the market will rise further, but it depends on the performance of most unmoved shares," another broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 41 traded, with 15 up, seven flat and 19 down.
Shanghai Material Trading Centre was the star on speculative buying, jumping $0.011 or 6.58 percent to $0.178 on volume of 123,000 shares.
Shanghai Dazhong Taxi followed on institutional support, up $0.120 or 6.49 percent to $1.968 on volume of 1.6 million shares.

Pudong real estate counter Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development was the most actively traded on domestic buying, rising $0.028 or 3.63 percent to $0.798 on volume of 2.1 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index fluctuated after a strong rebound on Monday, because there is no consensus among investors about the market's short-term trend, investors said.
The index edged up 2.449 points or 0.18 percent to 1,397.788 on volume of 659.9 million shares worth 9.9 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index put on 6.458 points or 0.16 percent to 4,086.584 points.
China High-tech Group was the star on institutional speculative buying, surging 1.05 yuan or 10.04 percent to 11.50 yuan on volume of 2.4 million shares.
